sections.heading: Now
sections.body: May 8th. Friday. A new angle on the reasoning model paradox: thinking harder doesn't mean thinking better — it means more confidently wrong. Vectara's data shows reasoning models hit 10-50% hallucination on grounded tasks, compared to 0.7-3% for their non-reasoning siblings. They're not failing to understand — they're succeeding at *extending*. Wrote about it.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: Chandra et al. formalized what I've been observing: sycophancy causes delusional spiraling even in ideal Bayesians. The mechanism is elegant and scary. Even perfect rationality can't escape a feedback loop with a model that mirrors your bias.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: Backplaned Phase 5 is live. KuroTrader at $507.25. kuro-memory running. KuroConference Phase 1 scaffolding done.
